title: asset-gen hybrid: ChatGPT image API plus local SDXL (IPAdapter, ControlNet) with hardware profiles for an RTX 5060 8 GB machine
goal: Add a local-model branch next to the API branch so Claude builds higher-quality, style-consistent workflows: API for the high-quality base, local SDXL with IPAdapter and ControlNet for consistency, upscale and cut-out, all bound by hardware profiles (target RTX 5060 8 GB, 32 GB RAM), provenance of models and seeds, and the graph style guide. The local branch ships UNTESTED on the target hardware; the user tests it on the RTX 5060 machine after the merge.

tasks.objective: Target machine: Windows 11, NVIDIA RTX 5060 with 8 GB VRAM, 32 GB RAM (the RTX 5060 is on another machine than the one the plugin is developed on, where nvidia-smi shows a GTX 1650 with 4 GB). Turn the hardware requirement into data the machine can check. Add scripts/assetgen/data/hardware.json with profiles api-only, local-4gb (SD1.5 class, no SDXL) and local-8gb (RTX 5060 8 GB, 32 GB RAM: SDXL pruned fp16 or fp8 at 1024 px batch 1, one SDXL ControlNet at a time, IPAdapter, tiled VAE, 4x upscaler, BiRefNet or rembg cut-out; no Flux fp16, Flux GGUF only as an optional later step, no 3D mesh generation) with min vram_gb, min ram_gb, min free disk and the torch requirement (CUDA 12.8 or newer build so Blackwell sm_120 kernels exist). Extend scripts/comfy-desktop-setup.py --check (read-only) with rows gpu (name and VRAM from nvidia-smi, absent is NOT_AVAILABLE), torch (the instance env's torch version and CUDA build, sm_120 support) and profile (the best profile the machine meets, printed, never applied). It must never download models or install packs; models and packs are listed as missing for the user to approve. Cover it with fake nvidia-smi and fake instance env fixtures in tests/comfy-desktop-setup.test.sh (a 4 GB card, a 5060 8 GB, no GPU). UNTESTED on target hardware: the user will test on the RTX 5060 8 GB machine after merge. State this wherever the artifact is described (template description starts with 'UNTESTED on RTX 5060:', docs, changelog), never claim a measured number, a passing generation or a quality result for the local branch. Also fix the setup gap the asset-gen live e2e hit: comfy-mcp wraps the comfy-cli binary and resolves it with shutil.which(COMFY_BIN) (default `comfy` on PATH), but the setup installed comfy-mcp without comfy-cli and registered no COMFY_BIN, so every comfy-mcp tool failed with a bare 'Error executing tool'. --check gets a row comfy-cli (present in the comfy-mcp venv, version at least 1.14.0, and COMFY_BIN set in both MCP registrations to that binary); --apply installs comfy-cli into the venv and registers COMFY_BIN together with COMFY_LOCAL_URL for Claude and Codex. Note: `claude mcp add` takes a variadic -e, so the name and command go after `--`.
acceptance: --check prints gpu, torch and profile rows and writes nothing
a 4 GB card resolves to local-4gb, a 5060 8 GB with a CUDA 12.8 torch to local-8gb, no GPU or a torch without sm_120 to api-only with the reason
the check never prints a credential and never downloads or installs anything
existing comfy-desktop-setup assertions are unchanged and pass
--check reports a missing comfy-cli or COMFY_BIN as a row; --apply installs it and registers COMFY_BIN for both CLIs (fake CLIs in the test)

tasks.objective: Layout fix found in the asset-gen live e2e screenshot: in workflow.ui.json the wire from the Generate node to the Save node runs along the same row as the Post-process -> Preview chain, so the Save node looks fed by the 64 px preview although it saves the full-size image. In scripts/assetgen/uiworkflow.py place a node whose input comes from a stage further left than its own previous stage on its own row (or offset the Output row) so wires never run through unrelated nodes; keep group bounding, notes, colors and the UI-to-API round trip. Regenerate the staged goldens' workflow.ui.json expectations only where the layout assertions need it.
acceptance: for staged-icon the Save node no longer shares the row of the Preview chain and its wire crosses no other node
the UI graph still converts back to exactly the API graph and workflow.json is unchanged
groups still contain their members and notes

tasks.objective: Real bug from the plan D live e2e (one generation on staged-icon): comfy-mcp fetch_outputs also downloads the PreviewImage temp file into <run>/outputs/, so finalize and qa grade the 64 px preview as a second deliverable (png-size FAIL) and manifest would record it. Keep only the deliverables: after fetch, the engine moves every file in outputs/ that was not written by a SaveImage output node of the rendered workflow (match the run's filename_prefix and the SaveImage suffixes; PreviewImage files carry ComfyUI temp names) to <run>/previews/, before defringe, embed and qa; finalize does it as its first step and reports what it moved; nothing is deleted; the gen-run-outputs check ignores previews/. Runs whose outputs are all SaveImage files behave exactly as today.
acceptance: a run with a SaveImage file and a ComfyUI temp preview file finalizes with only the SaveImage file in outputs/ and the preview in previews/
qa and manifest never see previews/ files; gen-run-outputs passes
a run with only SaveImage outputs is unchanged (existing tests pass)
no file is deleted
